title: Great Value
text:
This is my first time getting the beauty box. I absolutely love it definitely worth the value, I might not of used everything in the June box but there’s always some thing you can find that you like. This one came with a watermelon charcoal clarifying cleanser and did wonders for my teenagers face. You never know what you’re going to get and I definitely think it’s worth the price. Too bad you don’t get the free gift for first time signing up through Amazon. Otherwise it’s such a great deal.

Update: I have cancelled my subscription 3 boxes later and they all have a sheet mask and it’s 90% skin care.
label: neutral
